messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Take venlafaxine as prescribed by your doctor. Follow all directions on your prescription label and read all medication guides or instruction sheets. Your doctor may occasionally change your dose.
Take with food at the same time each day.
Swallow the extended-release capsule or tablet whole and do not crush, chew, break, or open it.
If you cannot swallow a capsule whole, open it and mix the medicine with applesauce. Swallow the mixture right away without chewing.
Tell your doctor if you have any changes in sexual function, such as loss of interest in sex, trouble having an orgasm, or (in men) problems with erections or ejaculation. Some sexual problems can be treated.
Your symptoms may not improve for up to several weeks. Do not stop using venlafaxine suddenly, or you could have severe and long-lasting unpleasant symptoms (such as agitation, confusion, tingling or electric shock feelings, aggression, violent behavior, suicidal thoughts, vision changes, or increased blood pressure). Ask your doctor before stopping the medicine.
Triplet: ["Venlafaxine", "requires doctor consultation before", "stopping the medicine"]

The relation 'requires doctor consultation before' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug should not be discontinued without prior evaluation and approval from a medical professional.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires doctor consultation before discontinuation': The subject drug should not be stopped abruptly without medical advice to prevent potentially harmful withdrawal effects.
B. 'has repeat course interval restriction': The subject drug should not be restarted within the specified time period unless prescribed by a doctor.
C. 'may require temporary discontinuation before': The subject medication might need to be stopped temporarily prior to undergoing the specified medical procedure.
D. 'has alternative therapy if stopped': If the subject drug is discontinued, the patient should be prescribed the therapy specified by the object entity to maintain treatment efficacy.
E. 'requires use of': The subject drug requires patients to use the specified product or practice to ensure safety or effectiveness.
